pages.lesson:
LESSON: NAMING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: SPEAKING
Topic 2.6: Naming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Naming. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Naming
2. Practise Naming at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Naming

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Naming
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Naming. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Naming at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Naming at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Naming
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Naming. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Naming using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Naming in the examples.
2. Explain Naming to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Naming.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Naming using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Naming important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Name colours with reference to objects in the environment.
2. Be engaged in identifying colours in the immediate environment.
3. Be taken for a nature walk and encouraged to identify colours.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Naming
2. Practise Naming at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Naming

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
